description: Source trial balances from Aurora, Sable and Kestrel, normalised for sign and locale, mapped to the group chart of accounts and translated into USD. This is the only layer whose contents originate outside the platform. It must balance independently for every entity and period, in both local currency and USD.

Elimination of intercompany revenue, cost of sales, management fees, royalties, interest, receivables, payables and loans. Every entry is generated by the elimination engine from matched entity pairs. Debits equal credits within the layer for every period (CTL-IC-06).

Investment-in-subsidiary elimination across the full ownership tree, purchase price allocation and acquired intangible amortisation, non-controlling interest allocation of profit and equity, and unrealised profit in inventory. Statutory entries that do not net to nil - they change the consolidated result.

Normalisations, reclassifications and pro-forma presentation entries prepared and approved by finance. EXCLUDED FROM THE STATUTORY RESULT. Every entry carries an adjustment_id with preparer, approver, narrative and reversal flag (CTL-CON-07).

The cumulative translation adjustment arising because assets and liabilities translate at closing rates while equity translates at historical and derived rates. Posted to the real foreign entity it belongs to, NOT to a virtual entity, because entity-level CTA is a genuine reporting requirement. It is the balancing entry that makes the translated trial balance sum to zero, so it does not balance independently - it is what makes layer 1 balance in USD.
